Name: 1oxnes and talkohlooeys' artstyle portraits -Always Raining in the Valley
Author: DreamWoIf
Description:
With permission from 1oxnes i finished the Portrait mod for Always Raining in the Valley

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9999]Always Raining in the Valley[/url]
[url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/1oxnes]1oxnes

[/url]This mod gave me quite a challenge! While Mia's portraits were already finished, I had to create Sterling completely from scratch—I hope he looks good to you all. 
[size=3]
[/size][size=3]Huge thanks to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/DolphinIsNotaFish]DolphinIsNotaFish[/url] for their incredible help with the code and for guiding me through it. ﻿

[/size]Unfortunately, Max's (Henry's dog) portrait couldn't be added because Custom Companions isn't very compatible with larger portraits.

If you notice any missing portraits, please let me know!
